mainEntity.name: Why does protection basis matter in a humanitarian residency matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key point is that defense and rights issues require calm, precise handling because the wrong response can affect status, deadlines, and later options. In real cases, protection basis changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
